run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum sum of pairs with difference less than k in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using parameter sets to verify correctness of transpiled code
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by using a sorted copy instead
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that sorts an array and greedily pairs adjacent elements with difference less than k
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes the maximum sum of pairs where each pair has a difference less than k
